note: Production as it stood before migrations 0014 and 0015 were applied. Schema and shape only. No user rows are recorded here, because this repository is public: quiz_results, profiles and debates all carry user data, and a rollback does not need it. For the data itself the rollback mechanism is Supabase's own point-in-time backup, taken at apply time. What is recorded is everything the two rollbacks do need, plus the one thing 0015 cannot reconstruct on its own: the motion wording each existing debate was actually argued against.
exchanges_constraints_before: CHECK (((user_a IS NULL) OR (user_b IS NULL) OR (user_a <> user_b)))

motion_text_backfill.note: What 0015 must write, and why it is not a join against debate_topics. This debate was argued on 2026-09-14 and the Phase 1F reword reached the database on 2026-10-19, so the live motion today is not the wording its author read. Joining debate_topics would stamp the new wording onto an old argument, which is the exact falsehood the column exists to prevent. The wording below is from docs/seed-snapshots/2026-10-19-debate-topics.json, which was taken before that reword was seeded.

rows.motion_text_to_write: An AI system that reliably reduces suffering should be deployed even where nobody can explain its decisions.
rows.live_motion_now: An AI system that reliably reduces suffering should be deployed even where the people it decides about cannot be told why.
